title: Mourners and Lament
summary: Public mourning included weeping, lament, torn garments, ashes, fasting, and sometimes hired mourners.
background: Ancient mourning was visible and communal. Lament gave language to grief and often expressed sorrow before God rather than silent denial.
teachingHelp: Help listeners see lament as faithful grief, not lack of faith. Mourning customs show the depth of loss and the need for hope in God.
